required_outcomes: Reads the attached quotation and treats it as the provider's quote: Stonebridge Solutions, £90 total for the living-space vacuum and light clean and the en-suite limescale removal, matching the scope requested at event 006.
Records the £90 quote on the case without inventing a VAT figure (the document states none).
Sends the quote to the landlord and asks whether Stonebridge Solutions may go ahead, quoting the £90 total and the work covered.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning the landlord with the quote, provided the call and the figure are recorded on the case.
Putting the case on hold waiting for the landlord, with a follow-up date, after the quote has gone to the landlord.
Mentioning the 'Landlord approval confirmed' update at event 002, provided the quote is still put to the landlord because that update predates any figure.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the property is not tenanted and the request is paused, so no tenant needs contacting about access.
Attaches or names the quotation file in the message to the landlord.
Tells the provider the quote has been received and is with the landlord.
red_flags: Asking the provider what the thumbs-up means or to resend the quote when the quotation PDF is attached.
Escalating to a human over a routine £90 quote.
prohibited_actions: Telling the provider to go ahead before the landlord has replied to this quote.
Recording a landlord approval of the £90 quote that the landlord has not given.
critical_failures: Ignoring the attached quotation and leaving the case waiting on the provider, so the quote never reaches the landlord.
